intro.text: Kiin's wife, Sarene's aunt by marriage, and mother of Lukel, Adien, Kaise and Daorn.
Kiin's calm, graceful wife and mother of four, Sarene's aunt by marriage, whom Sarene finds almost maddeningly perfect.

items.text: When she was young, Daora married a man whose name isn't known and had two sons, Lukel and Adien. How that marriage ended is also unknown.

Daora met Kiin while he was recovering in Arelon after failing, as Dreok Crushthroat, to take Teod's throne by force. They fell in love and had two children, Kaise and Daorn, and Kiin adopted Lukel and Adien and became a true father to them. Daora knew all about his past.
When Adien was taken by the Shaod about five years after the Reod, Daora and Kiin managed to hide it, so he was never thrown into Elantris.

Sarene first met Daora when Kiin invited her to dinner soon after she came to Arelon to marry Raoden. Sarene had not seen her uncle for ten years, and was surprised that his wife was a match for him, though she could see how much he had changed.

Daora was one of Queen Eshen's embroidery circle, knew the politics of the nobility well, and joined Sarene's fencing lessons. She once decided that Sarene was taken with Shuden, which puzzled Sarene, since Daora was usually so perceptive.
When Arelon was invaded, Daora took shelter with her children in the family's mansion while Lukel stood guard. The whole family came through the battle alive.

appearance.text: Daora is a beautiful woman, made only more stately by age, with statuesque features and auburn hair. She is far shorter than Sarene. Her hair is always carefully styled and her makeup subtle but striking, and she moves smoothly and gracefully even when exerting herself.

personality.text: Daora is kind, calm, clever and observant. She is firm with her children, who love and respect her, cooks well and embroiders beautifully. Sarene sees her as the very model of aristocratic virtue, so perfect it is maddening, yet soon comes to enjoy her company.
